_comment: Mock for GET /api/seller/products/1/risk (Classic White Shirt - MEDIUM risk: size chart is missing the sleeve column, which is also a top complaint area).
name: Classic White Shirt

field_impact.sleeve: 25% of fit complaints mention sleeve length - and the chart has no sleeve data for buyers to check

suggestions: Add sleeve length per size to the chart - it is the only missing field and the #2 complaint area.
Describe the cut as "relaxed through the body" so slim-fit buyers size down or pick another style; 'boxy waist' is the #1 complaint.
18% of reviewers say it runs large - add a "true to size, roomy fit" guidance note to reduce returns.

quotes.text: Sleeves came up short on me and there was no sleeve info in the chart to check
Fits like a tent around the waist, very boxy cut
Classic oxford, chest fits exactly like the chart says
